summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party is the market's favoured side. The Democratic candidates in four races also gained ground sharply: Josh Turek in [[Iowa]], Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]], James Talarico in [[Texas]] and Sherrod Brown in Ohio. The market lists each of those four contests as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Nevada]], where the Democrat Aaron Ford's chances rose sharply in the Polymarket odds, and the market treats the race as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sharp drop in the odds, and that race is also a predicted flip. The Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms also improved in the market's view in Georgia, a sizable move.
summaries.house: The Democrats' chances of winning House control slipped slightly in the Polymarket odds today. In [[NJ-02 (Vineland & Atlantic City)]], the Republican Jeff Van Drew saw a sharp drop in chances against the Democrat Zack Mullock, while in [[VA-01 (Williamsburg & Poquoson)]] the Democrat Shannon Taylor gained sharply on the Republican Rob Wittman, a predicted flip. The projected seat count also shifted to 240-195, down from 241-194, which still means Democrats gain control.
